name: fx-tests
description: Command-line access to the Firefox test-health data behind https://tests.firefox.dev/
// bin: Points at the launcher, not the esbuild bundle: bin/fx-tests.js is gitignored build output, and a git-URL install has no chance to build it (npm runs prepare in a bare cache clone before devDependencies exist). The launcher runs the TypeScript sources directly, so installing needs no bundler.
// files: An install runs from the TypeScript sources, so cli/ and lib/ ship and nothing else needs to. Without this the tarball also carries 4.5 MB of test fixtures and every dashboard .html, none of which the CLI reads.
// publishConfig: Not published to npm. `private: true` would block the git-URL install this is distributed by, so accidental publishing is prevented with a registry that refuses the request instead.
